formats: FileSourceManifest v4; SPM2/task v4/basis v3/overlay v3 unchanged; preserve/refuse file manifests v3
scope: Reference-workspace collection, not full-project archival. Same 32-entry editorless None input, one completed before and one completed final candidate; not ABBA or general large-project performance.

changes.ST-56: Retain changed before/after payloads, range-basis dependencies and prior retained content; compare directory roots directly, skip equal subtrees; bind retention and descriptor roots in generation fingerprint.
changes.ST-57: Publish at most 64 result descriptors per durable group, Complete before capture acknowledgement; Dispose never publishes an incomplete group.
changes.ST-58: Capture and fixed-result retry stop pruning aliases; retained-result maintenance at release still drains live/pending/history references before deletion.
changes.ST-59: Frozen source reads fetch only basis gaps not covered by private ranges.
changes.ST-60: Frozen directory listings carry metadata through sort and apply overlay/hidden/path-policy rules without repeated basis Stat.

interruptedCandidate.cause: WorkspaceStore required generation.Fingerprint == Revision, rejecting the new retention-bound fingerprint after state publication.
interruptedCandidate.normalStopInitiallyFailed: The stop client hit the same stale history check after one provider had stopped. No process was killed.
interruptedCandidate.repair: WorkspaceStore accepts SHA-256 fingerprint syntax distinct from Revision; the source provider still verifies exact retention/descriptor binding against the fixed receipt.
interruptedCandidate.state: Exact request, result, original/basis and task state preserved, all three providers absent; this diagnostic fixture was not counted as a completed lifecycle.

verification.note: guards-3 had one new test fixture handle-order failure; corrected new tests passed separately. Initial two raw-header expectation failures were updated for result-owned descriptors. One empty-filter invocation ran zero tests and is not counted.
verification.batchBoundaryNote: One additional <=65-byte zero-hole descriptor test proves the published 64-entry prefix survives a failure with entry 65 pending, then same-content retry publishes entry 65. Product code/binary unchanged after the completed native trial.

limitations: One sample each; no general improvement or isolated causal percentage.
Full catalog scans, independent payload revalidation, selected-apply broad metadata traversal and global maintenance scans remain.
Changed large files can still need their initial basis payload copied; no claim of zero copying for changed files.
No large/100k/17GiB, actual Unity/Git/Plastic lifecycle, OS crash, full gate, peak RSS or hardware saturation qualification.
